profiles.medicalNotes: DNR on file with Beacon Hill Health. Eleanor uses walking cane outdoors. Prefers medications with warm water or light applesauce.
Arthur is on blood thinners. Fall risk protocol active. Non-slip socks and bathroom grab bars installed.

medications.name: Metformin HCl
medications.instructions: Take with food to avoid stomach upset. Swallow whole, do not crush.

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.instructions: Take once every morning. Helps control blood pressure and protects kidneys.
warnings: May cause slight dizziness upon standing

medications.name: Atorvastatin
medications.instructions: Take before going to bed. Controls cholesterol.
warnings: Do NOT consume Grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking this medication!

medications.name: Glipizide
warnings: Have glucose tabs or snack ready if shaky

medications.name: Calcium Citrate + Vitamin D3
medications.instructions: Take with lunchtime meal for bone density support.
warnings: Do not take at the exact same moment as iron supplements

medications.name: Eliquis
medications.instructions: CRITICAL ANTICOAGULANT. Take exactly 12 hours apart. Do not skip.
warnings: CRITICAL: Do NOT take Aspirin, Ibuprofen, or NSAIDs
Report any unusual bruising or bleeding immediately

medications.name: Metoprolol Succinate
medications.instructions: Take every morning with breakfast. Controls heart rate rhythm.

medicationLogs.notes: Took with warm water before tea

appointments.title: Cardiology 6-Month Review & ECG

preparationChecklist.task: Bring updated printed medication list from CareBridge
Wear loose-fitting two-piece outfit for ECG chest electrodes
Bring Medicare and supplemental insurance cards

questionsForDoctor: Can we adjust the evening Metformin timing if mild indigestion recurs?
Is the knee arthritis responding adequately, or should we schedule a physical therapy review?
Check if blood pressure readings averaging 124/78 are within the ideal target window.

appointments.title: Diabetic Retinal Eye Exam
appointments.driverOrCompanion: Need family volunteer (eyes will be dilated for 3-4 hours)

preparationChecklist.task: Bring dark UV sunglasses for post-dilation ride home

questionsForDoctor: Check for any signs of diabetic microvascular changes in the macula.

appointments.title: Post-Stroke Neurological & Mobility Assessment

preparationChecklist.task: Bring walking quad-cane and wrist brace

questionsForDoctor: Can Arthur increase grip strengthening therapy duration?
Assess AFib stability with Eliquis dosage.

routines.title: Daily Hydration Target
routines.description: Vital for kidney health, preventing dizziness, and optimal medication metabolism.

routines.title: Morning Blood Pressure Check
routines.description: Monitor with Omron arm cuff before morning caffeine or medication.

entries.notes: Pulse 71 bpm. Eleanor was calm and rested.

routines.title: Fasting Blood Glucose
routines.description: Finger-prick glucometer test to monitor diabetes control.

routines.title: Gentle Garden Mobility Walk
routines.description: Helps joint mobility and cardiovascular endurance. Uses single-point cane.

entries.notes: Walked courtyard with Emily. Enjoyed the autumn sun!
Felt slight knee stiffness, rested after 15 mins.

careMessages.text: Good morning Mom! Emily and I will be coming over around 5:30 PM with your favorite vegetable minestrone. Remember to drink your afternoon water!

Shift update: Administered noon calcium. Eleanor was in wonderful spirits today and walked 20 mins. Blood pressure was a steady 124/78. Low pill warning noted for Glipizide (8 remaining) - pharmacy reorder queued.
Loved walking with you this morning Grandma! Your roses are looking so pretty.
